title: openEHR Base Types
description: OOJS representation of the openEHR BASE base_types specification (BASE Release 1.2.0). Covers the definitions, builtins, and identification packages.

BASIC_DEFINITIONS.description: Defines globally used constant values: CR, LF, Default_encoding (UTF-8), Any_type_name, None_type_name, Regex_any_pattern.

OPENEHR_DEFINITIONS.description: Inheritance class providing access to constants defined in other packages. Adds Local_terminology_id = 'local'.

VALIDITY_KIND.description: Enumeration of three constraint-model values: mandatory, optional, prohibited. Used as the type of attributes that express presence constraints on reference model attributes.

VERSION_STATUS.description: Status of a versioned artefact: alpha, beta, release_candidate, released, build.

value.description: One of: alpha, beta, release_candidate, released, build.

UID.description: Abstract parent of classes representing unique identifiers that durably identify a single information entity and are never re-used. All subtypes carry their value as a single string.

value.description: The string value of the identifier.

ISO_OID.description: ISO/IEC 8824 Object Identifier. Dot-separated integers where each non-leaf node identifies an assigning authority's namespace. Example: '2.16.840.1.113883'.

UUID.description: DCE Universal Unique Identifier (also known as GUID). Hexadecimal integers separated by hyphens in the pattern 8-4-4-4-12. Example: '87284370-2D4B-4e3d-A3F3-F303D2F4F34B'.

INTERNET_ID.description: Reverse internet domain identifier as specified by IETF RFC 1034. Dot-separated labels in reverse domain order. Example: 'uk.nhs.ehr1'.

OBJECT_ID.description: Abstract ancestor of all identifiers of informational objects. Used inside an object to identify that object (analogous to a database primary key). To reference another object use OBJECT_REF.

value.description: The string value of the identifier in the form defined by the concrete subtype.

UID_BASED_ID.description: Abstract UID-based identifier with an optional extension. Lexical form: root '::' extension, where root is a UID and extension is any string. The root identifies the conceptual namespace; the extension provides local disambiguation within that namespace.

HIER_OBJECT_ID.description: Concrete UID-based hierarchical identifier. Used to identify non-versioned objects. Example: '87284370-2D4B-4e3d-A3F3-F303D2F4F34B' or '87284370-2D4B-4e3d-A3F3-F303D2F4F34B::local'.

VERSION_TREE_ID.description: Version tree identifier for one version within a versioned container. Lexical form: trunk_version ['.' branch_number '.' branch_version]. Trunk numbering starts at 1. Example: '1', '2', '2.1.3'.

value.description: String form of the version tree identifier.

OBJECT_VERSION_ID.description: Globally unique identifier for one version of a versioned object. Lexical form: object_id '::' creating_system_id '::' version_tree_id. Example: '87284370-2D4B-4e3d-A3F3-F303D2F4F34B::uk.nhs.ehr1::2'.

ARCHETYPE_ID.description: Multi-axial identifier for archetypes. Lexical form: rm_originator '-' rm_name '-' rm_entity '.' concept_name {'-' specialisation}* '.v' number. Example: 'openEHR-EHR-OBSERVATION.blood_pressure.v1'.

TEMPLATE_ID.description: Identifier for templates. Lexical form to be determined by the openEHR specification.

TERMINOLOGY_ID.description: Identifier for a terminology accessed via a terminology query service. Lexical form: name ['(' version ')']. Examples: 'SNOMED-CT', 'ICD10AM(3rd_ed)', 'local'.

GENERIC_ID.description: Generic identifier for schemes not otherwise defined in openEHR. Carries a scheme name alongside the inherited value.

scheme.description: Name of the identification scheme to which this identifier conforms.

OBJECT_REF.description: A reference to another object that may exist locally or in an external namespace or service. Analogous to a database foreign key. Carries a namespace, a type name, and an OBJECT_ID.

namespace.description: Namespace in which the referenced object exists, e.g. 'local', 'unknown', 'demographic', 'terminology'. Legal values: 'local', 'unknown', or a string matching [a-zA-Z][a-zA-Z0-9_.:/?=+-]*.

type.description: Name of the class (concrete or abstract) of the referenced object, e.g. 'PARTY', 'COMPOSITION', 'VERSIONED_COMPOSITION'. Use 'ANY' if the type is unknown.

id.description: Globally unique identifier of the referenced object.

PARTY_REF.description: Reference to a party in a demographic or identity service. The type attribute is constrained to one of: PERSON, ORGANISATION, GROUP, AGENT, ROLE, PARTY, ACTOR.

LOCATABLE_REF.description: Reference to a LOCATABLE instance inside the top-level content of a VERSION. The id must be a UID_BASED_ID; the optional path is an absolute openEHR path applied to the object at VERSION.data.

path.description: Optional absolute path to the target instance within the versioned object. Absent means the root of the versioned object.
